name: Factory Direct Homes Center
description: Champion manufactured and modular homes with factory-direct pricing. Authorized dealer in Auburn, Indiana serving 6 states.

capabilities.name: browse_floor_plans
capabilities.description: Browse available Champion manufactured and modular home floor plans with specifications, photos, and pricing. Filter by type (single wide, double wide, modular), bedrooms, bathrooms, and square footage.

capabilities.name: get_financing_info
capabilities.description: Learn about financing options for manufactured homes including chattel loans, FHA loans, VA loans, USDA rural loans, and land-home packages. Includes partner lender information and pre-qualification guidance.

capabilities.name: check_delivery_area
capabilities.description: Check if a location is within our delivery area. We deliver throughout Indiana, Ohio, Michigan, Wisconsin, Illinois, and Kentucky, typically within 150 miles of Auburn, IN.

capabilities.name: get_pricing_estimate
capabilities.description: Get transparent pricing information. Single wides from $50K, double wides from $80K, modular from $100K. All pricing is line-item transparent with no hidden fees.

capabilities.name: contact_dealer
capabilities.description: Submit a contact form to reach Factory Direct Homes Center. Specify interest in single wide, double wide, modular homes, financing, or general information. Response within one business day.

capabilities.name: get_zoning_info
capabilities.description: Look up manufactured home zoning regulations and requirements for Indiana, Ohio, and Michigan. Includes permit requirements, placement rules, and local restrictions.

capabilities.name: get_site_preparation_info
capabilities.description: Learn about land preparation requirements for a manufactured home including foundations, utility connections, permits, grading, and typical costs.
